package.name: plynth_node
package.description: A ROS 2 robot connected to a building through Plynth's robot API: it sends where the robot is (its localizer's pose, in its own map), holds it when the building says so (/plynth/hold, for a twist_mux lock), and tells it the keep-out zones. Needs the plynth package from Plynth's robot kit (pip install the kit's wheel).
